ocrRegions.translatedText: So I was right after all♡...

ocrRegions.text: 押しませんでした？ブロデューサーさん今
ocrRegions.translatedText: Did you just push me, Producer?
...They've figured me out. Toying with me...

ocrRegions.text: んですか？誰と喋ってるさっきから
ocrRegions.translatedText: ...are you? Who have you been talking to this whole time?

ocrRegions.text: アイドルのくせにすっ転んでんだなーに
ocrRegions.translatedText: What, an idol like you takes a tumble?
Don't worry about it. I was just talking to myself.
